items.text: A clear "haves and have-nots" divide persists. While the "Magnificent 7" mega-cap leaders continue to support the major indexes, the equal-weighted S&P 500 shows significant underperformance and technical work ahead.

items.title: Advantest Corp (ATYYY / ATEYY)
items.text: A Japanese semiconductor equipment ADR with a market cap between $100B and $150B. The stock broke above a key trendline, surging 3.4% on volume 40% above its 50-day average, closing near the peak of its daily trading range. Its industry group ranks #27 out of 145.

items.title: ASE Technology (ASX)
items.text: A Taiwan-based semiconductor manufacturing provider forming a classic cup pattern. It is challenging resistance around the 45.52 area, advancing 3.5% on 12% above-average volume. Its industry group ranks #17 out of 145.

items.title: Shark Ninja (SN)
items.text: A strong non-tech consumer leader. After pulling back below its 50-day moving average line, it recovered strongly, clearing horizontal resistance at 180. Institutional quarter-end/month-end "window dressing" may provide additional tailwinds.

items.title: Upcoming Inflation Data
items.text: Markets are closely watching the upcoming inflation report for clues on monetary policy.

items.title: Fed Rate Hike Expectations
items.text: Fed funds futures currently price in a 50/50 chance of a rate hike at the October 28 meeting, with expectations for a second hike dropping to roughly 40%.

items.title: Earnings Watch
items.text: Micron Technology (MU) is scheduled to report earnings tomorrow after the close.

strategy.title: Focus on Individual Stock Rules
strategy.text: Listen to your portfolio's feedback over index action—if individual positions trigger stop-losses, cut them immediately.

strategy.title: Avoid Freezing Intraday
strategy.text: Implement hard broker stops or use the low of the first 5-minute bar to manage risk on pullbacks.

strategy.title: Incremental Execution
strategy.text: Scale in and out of positions gradually rather than making all-or-nothing moves.
